Had a chance to sit down with White Mountain Apache Chairman Kasey Velasquez today ahead of his testimony in front of the Natural Resources Committee. 

Our discussion was focused on water infrastructure, forest health, and ways BIE can better serve tribal students. https://t.co/xY2Sm8CnjE

Great seeing Mayor Daggett and the leadership team from Flagstaff today. 

We discussed our ongoing work regarding Rio de Flag, forest health and wildfire risk reduction, as well as efforts to improve Pulliam Airport. https://t.co/C1xL7LVUKF

Yesterday, I visited Restoration Forest Products' facility in Bellemont, AZ. 

They operate the largest sawmill constructed in Arizona and help protect the health of our forests. #AZ02 https://t.co/j14HBZlbji

Thank you, President Trump, for revamping our approach to forest health.

#AZ02 welcomes these proactive wins that provide long-term stability. https://t.co/Hzrt8JPZ5G

Yesterday, my staff visited Via Linda Behavioral Hospital in Scottsdale.

They provide exceptional mental health services for military personnel, veterans, and first responders.

We're grateful for their work. https://t.co/Egt5bIK7kC

We're proud to see these dedicated individuals join the ranks of Prescott Fire and Central Arizona Fire and Medical Authority.
